original.description: Panoramic photograph of the ruins of Fort de Loncin, Liège, in November 1918, from the Library of Congress Panoramic Photograph Collection. Catalogued as "Fort de Loncin, Liege, Belgium, Nov., 1918".
original.photographer: not identified in the catalogue record
original.archive: Library of Congress, Panoramic Photograph Collection, item 2007663088, via Wikimedia Commons
original.licence: public domain (Commons record: LicenseShortName "Public domain"; Permission "Public domain in the United States"; the record cites https://www.loc.gov/pictures/item/2007663088)

colorization.status: not colorized, and should not be. This is a photograph of a grave; colour would make it a landscape.

content_policy: ok on the catalogue description — ruined earth and masonry. As with the 1914 view, the image review (sand-y0u.7) must confirm the frame before publication.
caption: Fort de Loncin four years later, November 1918. The fort was never rebuilt and was never cleared; it is a war grave.
credit: Original photograph: photographer not identified, November 1918; Library of Congress, Panoramic Photograph Collection, item 2007663088; public domain.
notes: Verified 2026-08-24 against the Commons file record via the MediaWiki API. Dated 1918 and captioned as such — it is the epilogue to the Liège beats, not an illustration of August 1914. TIFF master: the pipeline derives WebP from it, so the size is not a problem, but the download is large.
